notes.title: Starcremental v1.1.4
notes.content:
- Added display of current morale to Victory Screen and Mutiny Screen.
- Fixed bug in starting morale when restarting higher Episodes.

notes.title: Starcremental v1.1.2
notes.content:
- "Randomize" button now gives a much better guaranteed run.
- The Log now truncates.  This should decrease save sizes and increase game speed, especially at later levels.
- Fixed an Action multiplier bug when restarting the 2nd or further Episode.
- Fixed the display of time modifier gains when completing Captains, Crews, Ships and Missions whose rewards had already been earned this Series.
- Added the ability to plan +1,000/-1,000 Actions by holding Shift+Ctrl.
- Clarified text relating to rewards already earned.

notes.title: Starcremental v1.1.1
notes.content:
- Autosave timer is no longer modified by time bonuses or triggered by events.  (This should help with remaining lagging and slowdown issues.)
- Holding down CTRL while adding to or removing a planned action now adds or removed 100.
- Fixed errors with Increasing, Decreasing and Zeroing Officers in the Plan Screen.
- Fixed a bug allowing Maximum Morale to be earned from cards whose rewards were already earned in a Series.
- Fixed display errors related to the rewards for a Captain, Crew, Ship or Mission already being earned in a Series.
- Fixed display error in logged Maximum Morale gains.
- Clarified hovers and messages related to rewards for Captains, Crews, Ships and Missions already being earned in a Series.
- Added a mute/unmute button to the Selection Screen.
- Clarified text generally.

notes.title: Starcremental v1.1.0
notes.content:
- Fixed bug slowing calculations with higher multipliers.
- Improved game speed in general.
- Corrected error in Temporary Bonus reward scaling.
- Improved and rebalanced scaling.
- Made event spawn timing match event decay timing.
- Clarified earned rewards on story/mission cards.
- Fixed visual progress bar overspill/underspill bug.
- Corrected several errors in data display in Mutiny and Victory screens.

This patch shouldn't break saves, but balance changes will have mixed effects on runs.

notes.title: Starcremental v1.0.6
notes.content:
- Fixed event generation timing to match even decay timing.
- Substantially improved game processing speed.

notes.title: Starcremental v1.0.5
notes.content: Fixed rare data structure crash bug.

notes.title: Starcremental v1.04
notes.content:
- Fixed crash bug with Time's Arrow.
- Fixed display bug with number of Episodes if mutinying after victory.

notes.title: Stacremental v1.0.3
notes.content: Fixed a crash bug related to corrupting planned actions.

notes.title: Starcremental v1.0.2
notes.content:
- Story completion achievements are now awarded in mutiny as well as victory.
- Fixed erroneous display of Maximum Morale gained in Mutiny and Victory screens.
